trap14.agGridTheme: ag-theme-balham (3 sites) — the exact theme that inlines its icon font as a data: URI. Forge font-src has no data:. Reuse backlog-prioritization-forge/scripts/extract-aggrid-font.mjs.

surveyVerdicts._source: findings/01-survey.md — holds the full apVerdicts / apRequestFamilies / nonApiV3Paths / storage / compiles / jsm blocks. Work orders inline the relevant rows from there; do not re-derive.

headlines.advanced-queues.js: DEAD — every AP.* site in it is dead (ResizeSensor targets #response-template-wrapper, a Response Templates leftover that does not exist here). Delete it and both script tags. Only live side effects are a console.error override and GA UA-181882142-5.
headlines.AP.events.on:525: LOAD-BEARING — one event, flag.action, opens the issue in a new tab. Substitute: showFlag onClose + router.open from @forge/bridge.
headlines.AP.jira.showJQLEditor:148: WRAPPER DEAD, CAPABILITY LIVE — JiraService.openJQLEditor has zero callers; the real sites are queue.component.ts:155 and widget.component.ts:54.
headlines.storage: All through storage.service.ts alone. Only PROJECT and USER are live. TICKET/DASHBOARD/APPLICATION are branch-only with no constructor anywhere.
headlines.trap2: DOES NOT APPLY — the APPLICATION-scoped store is empty on every tenant, so there is no global blob to move to @forge/kvs.
headlines.dataCarryForward: NEARLY A NO-OP — live data is Jira project/user entity properties, which Forge reads through the same REST API. The only Connect addon-property calls (:203, :210, :224) are unreachable and hold no data. APP_BASE_KEY is com.appbox.ai.advanced.queues and is shared across variants, so pinning to PRO does not renamespace anything.
headlines.compileBreak: development DOES NOT COMPILE — jira.service.ts:492 is missing the brace closing getSavedFilters() (opened :483). getAssignees/assignUserToIssue end up nested. Blocks Phase 1.
headlines.jsm: ONE servicedeskapi call, jira.service.ts:403 (import-native-queues dialog). The PRO descriptor declares no JSM module and no JSM condition, so the project page renders on every project type and getProjectQueues throws on non-JSM projects — a pre-existing bug the port inherits.
headlines.environmentVariant: environment.ts:30 picks the variant by hand-edited constant, NOT by an angular.json fileReplacement — so the committed tree builds FREE for every configuration including build-prod. Pin to ADVANCED_QUEUES_PRO.
headlines.shimHang: jira.service.ts:13-27 neither resolves nor rejects when AP is undefined — a latent hang to fix in the Forge shim, not port.

gateGap.problem: SCOPE_MAP has no JSM scopes. Verified: read:servicedesk-request against this descriptor returns UNKNOWN and exits 1.
gateGap.fix: Add the JSM read scope mapped to READ. Connect's READ already grants /rest/servicedeskapi/ GETs, so it is within ceiling — the gate just cannot see it. AQ is the first JSM app through.

trap13.why: Angular 13 + angular.json production config omits `optimization`, so it defaults to true → inlineCritical on → Forge CSP blocks the injected onload → ALL global CSS silently stops applying
trap13.fix: set production.optimization = { scripts: true, fonts: true, styles: { minify: true, inlineCritical: false } }

angularFloor.verdict: NO UPGRADE REQUIRED — this is the key difference from Backlog Prioritization
angularFloor.detail: Trap 15 sets the floor at Angular 13 / TypeScript 4.5 for @forge/bridge .d.ts to parse. AQ ships Angular 13.3.11 / TypeScript 4.6.4, exactly at the floor. Material 13 is pre-MDC so no legacy-* churn; ag-grid 27 needs no withComponents() fix.
angularFloor.buildScripts: angular.json scripts[] = marked.min.js, bootstrap.min.js (advanced-queues.js is NOT here — it loads from index.html:13)
